cli.intro: wolframscript -- Mathematica Form CLI (WolframScript-shaped; local evaluate)
cli.cmd.code: Evaluate Mathematica Form code and print the result
cli.cmd.file: Evaluate a .wl/.wls file and print the last result
cli.cmd.script: Run a script (shebang mode; silent unless Print / --print)
cli.cmd.jupyter.install: Install the SXO Mathematica Jupyter kernelspec
cli.cmd.jupyter.uninstall: Uninstall the SXO Mathematica Jupyter kernelspec
cli.cmd.jupyter.kernel: Run the Jupyter kernel (connection file from Jupyter)
cli.opt.print: Print last result, or each result when mode is all
cli.opt.json: Emit one JSON document on stdout
cli.opt.name: Kernelspec directory id (default sxo-mathematica)
